name: oa-chat
description: A ChatGPT-like AI chat app implementing unlinkable inference, where every session is unlinkable from each other and from your identity
author: Open Anonymity Team

scripts.prepare:nanomem: if [ -n "$GITHUB_PAT" ]; then git submodule set-url nanomem "https://${GITHUB_PAT}@github.com/OpenAnonymity/nanomem.git" && git submodule sync; fi; git submodule update --init nanomem
